name: Ragefire Chasm
summary: In Orgrimmar, Ragefire Chasm threatens the Horde from below. Magma lights its tunnels, where savage troggs gather. The Cleft of Shadow opens onto the caverns.

sections.title: A Threat Beneath the Streets
sections.body: Ragefire troggs threaten Orgrimmar from below. While Thrall works to secure Durotar above, the troggs infest the chasm’s unstable vents and magma rivers. They rose from unknown depths and violently rejected Magatha Grimtotem’s attempts at diplomacy. Left unchecked, their numbers could undermine the city and overrun it.

sections.title: The Searing Blade
sections.body: The Searing Blade plots against Thrall’s Horde from Ragefire Chasm. The warlock Jergosh the Invoker directs the sect with the satyr Bazzalan and the towering felguard Taragaman the Hungerer. Neeru Fireblade claims to oppose them, but the cult tests its strength and sabotages the orcs’ new home from below.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to Ragefire Chasm?
aliases: how to get to ragefire chasm
faq.answer: Enter Ragefire Chasm through the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar, beside the tent of the warlock Neeru Fireblade.

Aggressive Ragefire troggs infest the chasm, and the Searing Blade occupies it. The cult is linked to the Shadow Council and led by Jergosh the Invoker, a warlock, Bazzalan, a satyr, and Taragaman the Hungerer, a felguard.

faq.q: Why hasn't Thrall cleared out the chasm?
faq.answer: The Horde is stretched thin establishing Durotar and defending against outside threats. Warchief Thrall relies on capable champions to enter the caverns, defeat the Searing Blade’s leaders, and thin the trogg numbers before they can breach the city streets.

faq.q: Can Alliance players enter Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Yes. You can reach Ragefire Chasm by slipping through Orgrimmar’s gates and descending into the heavily guarded Cleft of Shadow. For Alliance adventurers, the undertaking is perilous.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you face a security crisis at the heart of the capital. Protecting the young Horde falls to its newest adventurers.
As a warlock, you see the corruption of fel magic in the Searing Blade and its demonic masters. Thrall’s new Horde seeks to root out that corruption.
